title: Export mistakes are reported with their location and leave nothing half-written
description:
As a producer, I want every export mistake reported with where it is, and no half-written set left behind, so that I can fix it and export again.

```gherkin
Feature: Export mistakes are reported with their location
  Scenario: A score with mistakes is not exported
    Given the score "bad.apr" with an unknown clip on line 4
    When I export "bad.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the export fails
    And the error names "bad.apr" line 4 and the unknown clip
    And no set folder exists

  Scenario: A sample file that is missing
    Given the score "gone.apr" whose clip "horn" on line 2 names a sample with a manifest but no audio file
    When I export "gone.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the export fails
    And the error names line 2, the clip "horn" and the missing file's path

  Scenario: A library sample that is not on this machine
    Given a library whose sample for "horn" is only in the cloud
    When I export "gone.apr" as a DAW set with "--library" set to that library
    Then the export fails
    And the error names the clip "horn" and says to run "apricity sync pull"

  Scenario: An existing set is not overwritten by accident
    Given I exported "tune.apr" as a DAW set
    When I export "tune.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the export fails
    And the error names the existing folder and "--force"
    When I export "tune.apr" as a DAW set with "--force"
    Then the export succeeds

  Scenario: A failed export leaves nothing behind
    Given the output folder cannot be written
    When I export "tune.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the export fails with the folder's path
    And no partial set or sample copy remains
```
